title: Creamy Tuscan Chicken
description: Seared chicken in a smoked paprika, garlic and parmesan cream sauce with crisp-tender fresh broccoli over Impastable pasta.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Season {thighs} and {breasts} with {salt} and {pepper}. Pound the breasts thin and even with the KitchenAid tenderizer if you have not already.

steps.title: Sear chicken
steps.text: Heat {oil} in a 12 inch cast iron skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken 4 minutes per side until deeply golden. It does not need to be cooked through. Move to a plate.

steps.title: Bloom spices
steps.text: Reduce heat to medium. Add {garlic}, {grangarlic}, {paprika} and {italian} to the pan and stir 30 seconds until fragrant.

steps.title: Deglaze
steps.text: Pour in {broth} and scrape up the browned bits. Simmer 2 minutes.

steps.title: Cream sauce
steps.text: Stir in {cream} and simmer 5 minutes until the sauce coats a spoon.

steps.title: Add cheese
steps.text: Reduce heat to low and stir in {parmesan} until smooth.

steps.title: Cook pasta
steps.text: Cook {pasta} in salted water according to the package. Drain.

steps.title: Finish in sauce
steps.text: Return the chicken to the sauce and add {broccoli}. Cover and simmer 6 to 8 minutes until the broccoli is crisp-tender (al dente) and the chicken reaches 175°F for thighs and 165°F for breasts on the Thermapen.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Slice the chicken and serve over the pasta with plenty of sauce.

notes: Result: Glenn 9.2, Cindy 9.5. Quantities are starting points (the saved version had no amounts); the next cook should go heavier on smoked paprika, jarred minced garlic and Italian seasoning. Thighs would push it to 10/10. Fresh broccoli reheats better than frozen; add it earlier in the sequence than the final minutes if you like it softer. Reheat gently with a splash of broth.
